caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered within a large square border on a plain background, executed in grayscale pencil or ink. The object is shaped like a goblet or chalice with a wide, rounded base that narrows into a slender stem, then widens sharply into a conical cup with a slightly domed cover. A small, irregularly shaped protrusion resembling a wick is visible at the top. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset sketch of the same object, accompanied by measurements: “7 7/8” in height and “2 3/8” at the base. The main depiction shows shading and texture to suggest three-dimensionality. The artist’s signature, “M. Mangialcotti,” appears in the bottom right corner of the large square. The background is a light beige or off-white.
title: Lamp
